title.en: Google announces a read-only Wallet connection for Gemini
title.zhHans: Google 宣布 Gemini 可只读连接 Wallet

searchSummary.en: Google announced an optional Google Wallet connection for U.S. Gemini app users, providing read-only financial insights.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 宣布向美国 Gemini 应用用户推出可选的 Google Wallet 连接，用于只读财务洞察。

summary.en: Dated 2026-11-13: Google announced an optional Google Wallet connection for U.S. Gemini app users, providing read-only financial insights.
summary.zhHans: 2026-11-13，Google 宣布向美国 Gemini 应用用户推出可选的 Google Wallet 连接，用于只读财务洞察。

narrative.en: Google describes the optional connection as read-only and says Gemini cannot move, manage or invest money through it. The announcement and reporting do not establish the number of people who connected accounts or independently tested every restriction.
narrative.zhHans: Google 将该可选连接描述为只读，并称 Gemini 无法借此转移、管理或投资资金。公告和报道都不能证明实际连接人数，也不构成对全部限制的独立测试。
